lead: Ramanand Sagar was a film director, born on 29 December 1917 in Lahore.
He died on 12 December 2005 in Mumbai at the age of 87.
He has 18 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Director and Padma Shri in arts.
This profile collects the Ramanand facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
